entries.subject: the Buddha
entries.object: staying near Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove

spans.text: At one time the Buddha was staying near Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.
Tatra kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi: There the Buddha addressed the mendicants, “bhikkhavo”ti.

entries.task_id: where māra|has|sown the seed and those worldly pleasures of the flesh?
entries.description: where Māra has sown the seed and those worldly pleasures of the flesh?
entries.subject: where Māra
entries.object: sown the seed and those worldly pleasures of the flesh?

spans.text: Why don’t we set up our lair close by where Māra has sown the seed and those worldly pleasures of the flesh?
Then we can encroach on where Māra has sown the seed and those worldly pleasures of the flesh, and enjoy eating without being reckless.
We won’t become indulgent, then we won’t become negligent, and then Māra won’t be able to do what he wants with us on account of that seed and those worldly pleasures of the flesh.’
